entries.def:
ἱμάτιον, -ου, τό 
(dim, of εἷμα, a garment), [in LXX chiefly for בֶּגֶד also for שִׂמְלָה, שַׂלְמָה, etc. ;] 
a garment, but in usage always (exc. in p1., see infr.) of an outer garment, a mantle, cloak (thrown over the χιτών; see Rutherford, NPhr., 22; DCG, i, 499a): Mat.9.16, 20-21 Mrk.2.21; 5.27-28, 30 Jhn.19.2, Act.12.8, al.; opposite to χιτών, Mat.5.40, Luk.6.29, Act.9.39; pl., garments, clothes (i.e. the cloak…

ἱματισμός, -ού
(ιματίζω), [in LXX: Gen.24.53, 2Ch.18.29, Ezk.16.18, al. (בֶּגֶד); Exo.3.22; 12.35, Rut.3.3, al. (שִׂמְלָה), etc. ;] 
clothing, apparel (usually of sumptuous attire; see Tr., Syn., § 1): Luk.7.25; 9.29, Jhn.19.24 (Psa.22.19, LXX for לְבוּשׁ), Act.20.33, 1Ti.2.9.†
(AS)

ἱμείρω [in LXX: Job.3.21 B3R (ABא, ὁμ-) ;] 1Th.2.8 (Rec.), see: ὁμείρομαί.
(AS)

ἵνα, 
__I. adverb (poët., Hom., al.), 
__1. of place, where, whither. 
__2. of circumstance, when. 
__II. Conjunction, 
__1. prop., final, denoting purpose or end (cl.), that, in order that, usually the first word in the clause, but sometimes (cl. also) preceded by an emphatic word (Act.19.4, Rom.11.31 (?), Gal.2.10, al.); 
__(a) with optative (so in cl. after historic tenses): after a pres., Eph.1.17 (but WH, mg.,…
Why is it that? For what reason? Why?, Mat.9.4; 27:46; Luk.13.7; Act.4.25 7:26; 1Co.10.29*

Ἰόππη (FlJ, id., and also Ἰόπη), -ης, ἡ, (Heb. יָפוֹ), 
Joppa: Act.9.1-43; 10.1-48; 11.1-30.†
(AS)

Ἰορδάνης, -ου, ὁ (Heb. יַרְדֵּן), 
the Jordan: Mat.3.5, Mrk.1.5, al 
(AS)

ἰός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX: Ezk.24.6, 11-12 (חֶלְאָה), Psa.140.3 (חֵמָה), al. ;] 
__1. an arrow. 
__2. rust (Ez, l.with): Jas.5.3 (cf. MM, Exp., xv). 
__3. poison: figuratively, Rom.3.13 (Ps. l.with), Jas.3.8.†
(AS)

Ἰούδα, (a) Ἰουδαῖος, ὁ, a Jew: Jhn.4.9, Act.18.24, Rom.2.28; pl., Rev.2.9; 3.9; οἱ Ἰ., Mat.2.2, Mrk.7.3, Jhn.2.6, al.; Ἰ. τε καὶ Ἕλληνες, Act.14.1, al.; κ. προσήλυτοι, Act.2.10 ἔθνη τε κ. Ἰ., Act.14.5 οἱ κατὰ τὰ ἔθνη, Act.21.21 of Jewish Christians, Gal.2.13 of the ruling class who opposed Jesus, Jhn.1.19; 2.18; 5.10; 11.8; 13.33, al.; 
__(b) Ἰουδαία, -ας, ἡ (sc. γῆ, χώρα, cf. Jhn.3.22, Mrk.1.5), (Heb. יְהוּדָה),…

§ Judea, Judean, "land of the Judahites" 
Judea, the southern party of the country, below Samaria, Mat.2.1, 5, 22; 3:1; metonymy the inhabitants of Judea
